Hi Maya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our end: we covered Redwood's deployment options, data isolation for healthcare workloads, and the security checklist you asked about.

High-level status:
- SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 Type II auditing in flight; I can share the latest bridge letter and our auditor contact (see attachment).
- HIPAA: We have BAAs available for customers who require them — happy to route legal if needed.

To help your security team complete the vendor assessment, could you confirm if you can start the questionnaire we attached? In parallel, we can provide an IAM evidence pack (items below) to accelerate review:

Requested IAM evidence (suggested attachments):
- SSO/SAML metadata (IdP SP metadata file + ACS endpoints)
- SCIM provisioning documentation and supported attributes
- RBAC / role matrix (admin/owner/devops/observer) with UI screenshots
- Admin controls & MFA enforcement screenshots (org settings)
- Audit/log retention policy and example audit log entries (redacted)

We've attached a short guidance doc that explains what each item looks like and sample filenames. If you want, Prioym (cc'd) can assemble the pack and drop it into a shared Drive link.

Next steps:
1) Maya to confirm who will own the questionnaire on your side and share the link
2) Prioym to assemble IAM evidence pack and share Drive link
3) Marissa/Aditya to coordinate timing for procurement/legal if SOC2/BAA are needed.

Attachments: Redwood_IAM_Evidence_Guidance.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up in ~24 hours unless I hear from you sooner.

Best,
